headline: Executive order calls for bringing back service members who were discharged for not following the military's COVID-19 vaccine requirement.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with service members who were discharged from the military under its COVID-19 vaccination mandate. It calls for those people to be reinstated, meaning allowed to return to military service. The available information does not say how reinstatement would work, who qualifies, or whether pay, rank, or benefits would be restored.

who_it_affects.group: Former service members discharged for not getting the COVID-19 vaccine
who_it_affects.how: They may be able to return to military service under this order.

who_it_affects.group: Military branches and the Department of Defense
who_it_affects.how: They would be responsible for carrying out the reinstatement of these former members.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 27, 2025; the provided information does not give a separate start date or deadlines.
